sources.title: CivArchive (CivitAI Archive) - AI Model Archive
sources.snippet: Browse and discover AI models from CivitAI, TensorArt, and SeaArt. Community-driven archive preserving access to AI resources.

sources.title: AI Model Detector — Which AI Made This Image? | PromptShotAI
sources.snippet: Free AI model detector. Upload any image and find out which AI generated it — Midjourney, Flux, SDXL, DALL-E, or Ideogram — with a confidence score and visual tells.

sources.title: Scan your repo for retiring AI models — ModelCanary
sources.snippet: Scan your repo for retiring models Paste a public GitHub repo. We look for AI model IDs in your code and flag the ones that are retiring, retired or had price changes.

sources.title: AI Model Index
sources.snippet: Search and explore AI models across providers, modalities, and capabilities. Currently supported providers: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, and Mistral AI. See the Model Inclusion Policy for details on selection criteria.
